Description: Collects entry fee in KC, burns 1.25 KC, transfers 11.25 KC to treasury, initializes GameSession with default values, sets random seed from timestamp.
Handles one day’s events on-chain, applies random price/event effects, executes trades, increments day_count, ends session if 30 days passed.
Finalizes session, awards points, updates PlayerProfile, enforces caps (50M per month), emits SessionResult event, closes session account.
Processes permanent item purchase, burns 20% of cost, transfers 80% to treasury, marks item as owned, optionally mint NFT.
Utility function to determine tier and APR based on points, max 13% APR, likely used in staking program.
GameSession for per-game state, PlayerProfile for persistent player data, monthly points reset externally, supports multi-game rules.
Defines accounts/signers for each instruction, uses Anchor constraints for validation, PDAs ensure only program creates accounts, player must sign transactions.
Custom GameError enum for failure cases, Anchor returns codes/messages if constraints fail, ensures atomic operations and game rules enforcement.
